# Offline provider fixtures

`firms.csv` is a synthetic two-row example using the NASA FIRMS VIIRS area CSV
columns. It is not a recorded live detection response. Attribute definitions:
https://firms.modaps.eosdis.nasa.gov/content/descriptions/FIRMS_VIIRS_Firehotspots.html
API request structure: https://firms.modaps.eosdis.nasa.gov/api/area/
Checked 2026-10-17: coordinates in degrees, acquisition times UTC, FRP in MW.
